upload_diff_to_codereview: upload a diff from git or svn to the codereview app using RealMain
guess_version_control_system: guess the version control system in the current directory using GuessVCS
split_patch_into_files: split a unified diff into separate per-file patches using SplitPatch
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data using EncodeMultipartFormData
run_shell_command: run a shell command and capture stdout and return code using RunShellWithReturnCode
